set.body: Split from the S7.1 decision (bd-01M3DPFRZDVYGNYMV6890SDN20) by lane-analysis. An optional declared expected-unmatched selection, such as an old/new column in the trial inventory, so a lure or novel probe can never be paired with a studied item through an id collision. It changes the persisted recipe: a new plan field with its diff, form, descriptor, codec schema rung and laws, plus focal selection ahead of both schedules.
set.title: Recipe: declared expected-unmatched selection (old/new column)
